cells.quote: The airplane on the left is shown in a cruise condition while the airplane on the right is shown in a takeoff or landing condition.
This slide shows the projected surface area for two different aircraft.
The airplane on the left is shown in a cruise condition while the airplane on the right is shown in a takeoff or landing condition.
Takeoff and landing are times of relatively low velocity, so to keep the lift high (to avoid the ground!) designers try to increase the wing area.
